points.point: The Vault's automotive requirement notes map to the R&S CMX500 (NG eCall / EN 17240:2024 verification), not to a VNA.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention NG eCall/CMX500 or that automotive requirement notes map to non-VNA CMX500

points.point: The other automotive-specific R&S instrument recorded is the AREG800A automotive radar echo generator, covering 76–81 GHz radar echo generation rather than S-parameter measurement.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention AREG800A or 76–81 GHz radar echo generation rather than S-parameters

points.point: Automotive high-speed requirements in the Vault are expressed as ADAS and V2X needing high-speed signal transmission, and as Automotive SerDes Alliance standards for in-vehicle high-speed data links — with no measurement parameter attached.
points.label: contradicted
points.why: mentions Automotive SerDes links but maps them to SI parameters, whereas reference says no measurement parameter is attached

points.point: In-vehicle high-speed links appear only as a standards category, without stated test parameters or instrument requirements.
points.label: contradicted
points.why: treats in-vehicle high-speed links as leading to parameters and VNA needs, not only as a standards category

points.point: The only automotive-to-parameter hint is material-level: Low DK glass fabric is listed for high-frequency/high-speed PCB, server, automotive and communication use, making Dk/Df the associated measurable parameter.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions DK/DF among PCB parameters but omits Low DK glass fabric and the material-level automotive hint

points.point: The Vault states these dielectric/loss parameters are extracted with VNA-based solutions (Delta-L loss, TDR impedance, Dk/Df extraction), though the cited instruments are competitor ENA/PNA.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions IL/TDR impedance/DK/DF but not VNA-based extraction via Delta-L/TDR/Dk-Df or competitor ENA/PNA context

points.point: R&S VNA cases in the Vault tie measurable parameters (impedance, insertion loss, return loss) to a required capability set of multi-port VNA plus probe, mount-kit and de-embedding tool — but for PCB/SoC/connector DUTs, not automotive ones.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions IL/impedance and deembedding with a VNA, but omits return loss, multi-port/probe/mount-kit tooling, and PCB/SoC/connector limitation

points.point: A concrete VNA capability the Vault documents is the 4-port R&S ZNB3044 covering 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz with 1.85 mm ports.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention 4-port R&S ZNB3044, 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz, or 1.85 mm ports

invented: Automotive in-vehicle high-speed data links → PCB/channel SI parameters ... → VNA capability requiring sufficient frequency coverage, dynamic range, measurement bandwidth, and calibration/deembedding support
